hero.title: Sri Krishnadevaraya College of Agricultural Sciences
hero.summary: SKCAS is a self-financed agriculture college in Anantapuramu, established in 2016 under Sri Balaji Educational Society. It is affiliated to ANGRAU and describes agricultural education tied to farming needs such as crop protection, organic farming and seed technology.

overview.heading: Agricultural education in Anantapuramu
paragraphs: Sri Krishnadevaraya College of Agricultural Sciences identifies itself as a self-financed, unaided private coeducational institution. Founded in 2016 under Sri Balaji Educational Society, it is affiliated to Acharya N. G. Ranga Agricultural University. Its public contact address is on Alamuru Road in Anantapuramu.

The college’s stated academic focus connects agriculture study with the needs of farming communities, including pest management, organic production and seed technology. Its about page describes a 110-acre setting. Applicants comparing it with other Andhra colleges should ask for a current farm-use schedule, laboratory inventory and university admission notice so that the practical experience and full costs can be assessed alongside the degree title.

admissions.heading: Planning an application to SKCAS
admissions.intro: The college homepage carries a 2026–27 management-seat banner, while a retrievable university web-options notice relates to 2022–23. Neither establishes today’s vacancy position or current entry thresholds. Use the current ANGRAU notification and confirm availability directly. For Sri Krishnadevaraya College of Agricultural Sciences, the applicable ANGRAU counselling route now has a revised 30 October 2026 notice: registered candidates follow the stated November rank/category session and check the university’s live seat position. Being called does not guarantee admission.

campus.heading: A published agricultural campus setting
campus.intro: SKCAS’s departmental descriptions identify a horticultural garden with propagation structures and model orchards, and a soil-science teaching laboratory. Entomology material links final-year rural experience to crop-pest problems.

facilities.name: Horticultural teaching garden
facilities.description: The department describes propagation structures, a crop cafeteria and model fruit orchards.

facilities.name: Soil-science laboratory
facilities.description: A dedicated laboratory is described for undergraduate practical experiments.

facilities.name: Separate hostel buildings
facilities.description: SKCAS describes separate boys’ and girls’ buildings, each with 40 rooms. The published layout includes dining/kitchen areas, warden/caretaker offices and visitors’ space; rooms are described as shared by three or four students with basic study furniture.

facilities.name: SC/ST scholarship application assistance
facilities.description: The college’s SC/ST Cell describes help with government scholarships and fee-reimbursement matters for eligible students, including hostel residents. The page is a support-channel description and does not publish a current award matrix.

practical_learning: The entomology department describes RAWE and crop-protection practical learning.
